text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第1批 · 07 · 云层之上的城市客厅.
Environment: A richly observed film set with a specific emotional story, original architecture and arrangement, not a replica of a film frame. Vicky aesthetic: luminous high-key exposure with retained highlight detail, cream white, pale gray, warm natural brown, restrained pastel accents, broad soft daylight, filled low shadows, fine natural material texture and wear, very subtle film halation and grain, elegant believable photographic realism. Eye-level natural 50mm perspective, layered foreground/midground/background, gentle depth separation but environment clearly readable. Space reserved at central lower midground for future character compositing. ABSOLUTELY EMPTY ENVIRONMENT: no people, no characters, no animals, birds or insects, no human silhouettes, no human reflections, no hands, no faces on paintings, posters or screens, no statues or mannequins. No logos, watermarks, readable text. Avoid CGI real-estate renders, sterile showrooms, excessive bloom, orange grading, deep black shadows, ultrawide distortion. Scene: a warm near-future urban apartment during bright hazy late morning, original lived-in environment. Floor-to-ceiling corner windows on rear and right reveal a soft pale-gray dense city with planted rooftops. Natural oak wall panel to left, low ivory fabric sofa, one muted pale apricot cushion, light warm brown table holding a ceramic cup, a closed book and tiny unobtrusive wood-framed device with blank screen. A cream woven blanket draped casually, low bookshelf, a single leafy plant far side. Eye-level camera from adjoining hallway, soft doorway in left foreground, open center floor and expansive view beyond. Technological comfort expressed through simplicity and fine tactile materials, no holograms or neon, no giant sci-fi equipment. Research inspiration: Her production designer's warm natural materials, open windows and reduced visual noise. Emotion: gentle solitude and hope.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic architectural elevation or cut section of the principal facade / interior wall. Show openings, vertical structure, floor levels, stair and roof relationships where visible. Readable architectural profile with restrained white margin and a short elevation title.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create one spatial reference image for 电影场景第1批 · 07 · 云层之上的城市客厅. Image1 is exact visual style and scene identity reference. Image2 is the spatial layout authority. Preserve same single location, all door/window/landmark/furniture relationships. Unseen sides may be reconstructed conservatively. One flat architectural orthographic main facade elevation or interior principal wall elevation. Show openings, structural bays, vertical proportions, ceiling profile and material detail. No perspective montage, no furniture moved against the elevation. White page, title INTERIOR ELEVATION or FRONT ELEVATION. No people, animals, human pictures or silhouettes. No invented numbers/dimensions. Preserve original materials, palette and lighting. No added rooms or unrelated locations.
